name: Cherry Tomato & Garlic Shrimp Sauté with Cornmeal Drop Biscuits

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, combine flour, cornmeal, baking powder, sugar, and salt; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ cup all-purpose flour
¾ cup polenta (cornmeal)
1 tbsp baking powder
1 ½ tsp brown sugar
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Using a box grater, coarsely grate cold butter into the bowl with the flour. Using two hands, combine the flour and butter by rubbing the mixture between your thumbs and fingers until it looks crumbly. Add the milk and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup butter, unsalted
355 ml whole milk

instructions.primary_message: Using a scant ¼-cup measure, drop portions of batter onto a large baking sheet pan, spacing them 2-inches apart. Place in the oven and bake until lightly golden, about 15 minutes.

Meanwhile, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Transfer shrimp to a plate and season with salt and pepper on both sides; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small bunches green onions (scallions)
3 small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ lemons
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard ends of the green onions; cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces. Halve tomatoes crosswise.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add green onions, tomatoes, garlic, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring often, until tomatoes have softened, about 4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp butter, unsalted
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add shrimp to the skillet; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until cooked through and opaque, about 5 minutes. Juice lemons into the skillet and stir to combine; remove from heat.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
To serve, divide shrimp and biscuits between bowls or plates and garnish with parsley. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
